title: #14 Overpackage
prompt: Do you think consumers should avoid over-packaged products or is it the responsibility of manufacturers to avoid extra packaging? Give your views or any relevant examples based on your own experience.

promptSegments.text: Do you think consumers should avoid over-packaged products or is it the responsibility of manufacturers to avoid extra packaging?

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.
requirements.vi: Trả lời mọi câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point discusses the consumer's role in reducing waste by choosing products with less packaging.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point discusses the consumer's role in reducing waste by choosing products with less packaging.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point discusses the manufacturer's role in reducing waste by changing how they package items.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point discusses the manufacturer's role in reducing waste by changing how they package items.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Consumers have power to reduce waste by choosing less packaged goods.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Consumers have power to reduce waste by choosing less packaged goods.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Companies must take action to make things better by using simpler materials.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Companies must take action to make things better by using simpler materials.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph focuses on the consumer's personal power and choices in reducing waste.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph focuses on the consumer's personal power and choices in reducing waste.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph focuses on the manufacturer's duty to redesign products and use less material.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph focuses on the manufacturer's duty to redesign products and use less material.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Consumers have the power to reduce waste by choosing products with minimal packaging, such as selecting a bar of soap without a plastic box.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Consumers have the power to reduce waste by choosing products with minimal packaging, such as selecting a bar of soap without a plastic box.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Manufacturers are best positioned to reduce waste because they have the power to change product design, for example, by using paper instead of plastic for food containers.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Manufacturers are best positioned to reduce waste because they have the power to change product design, for example, by using paper instead of plastic for food containers.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
